items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Sarah had me, I made an orchestration for her.

ctx.x: she had, you know, just a little orphan kid. And then we went from there, we only stayed at the Harlem Opera House for about two months, and then we moved into the Apollo Theatre, and the Amateur Hour was still on, and Earl Hines was the bandleader of the week, and I said to Earl, hey, we got a kid here, Sarah Vaughn, and she's great.
Sarah? You got Sarah started too? Before you go into Sarah, did Ella win the amateur contest at the Harlem Opera House or the Apollo Theatre?
